verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own llms.txt states 'Public API: None' because the product is local-first and has no agent-callable endpoint, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. The '2FAS API' mention is future-tense ('you'll be able to') and describes letting third-party services onboard their customers to 2FA, not a documented API for users to drive the product. Agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors, pricing.md) are documentation plumbing, not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
